lines.en: I walk over the sugar frosting.
My hem sweeps the candy bricks.
I come slowly out of the tower.
I circle a lollipop pillar.
My heels click on the candy floor.
I pace your way.
I sweep my hair back.
I skirt the syrup pool.

lines.zh: 我踩着糖砖，一步比一步近。
lines.en: I walk the sugar bricks, closer with every step.
I slowly turn my body.
I walk on, skirt trailing.

lines.zh: 我在软糖堆上停了一下。
lines.en: I pause on the gummy heap.
I stand with sugar on my fingers.
I lick my fingertip.

lines.zh: 我在挑一根最好的棒糖。
lines.en: I am picking the best lollipop.
My skirt sways gently.
I tilt my head your way.
I stir the syrup in my hand.

lines.zh: 我只笑着，糖锅在身后冒泡。
lines.en: I only smile while the sugar pot bubbles behind me.
My smile is sweet, and cold.
I pop a candy in my mouth.
I rotate my wrist slowly.
I stand at the tower gate, still.
I count the candy bricks.

lines.zh: 我在数罐子里还剩几颗糖。
lines.en: I count the candies left in the jar.
I turn a candy between my fingers.
I rise on my toes to look far.

lines.zh: 我把糖纸折成一个小角。
lines.en: I fold a wrapper into a little corner.
I hum a short tune.
I wait for the syrup to change color.
I look up with a sweet smile.
Would you like something sweet?
I tilt my head and size you up.
There is a little glint in my eyes.
I beckon you over.

lines.zh: 你身上只有铁和汗的味道。
lines.en: You smell of iron and sweat, nothing sweet.
I hide both hands behind my back.

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，像在挑一颗糖。
lines.en: I narrow my eyes as if picking out a sweet.

lines.zh: 我舔掉嘴角的糖霜，看着你。
lines.en: I lick the frosting from my lip and watch you.
I take half a block toward you.
I am deciding which candy to give you.

lines.zh: 我笑出声，牙上还黏着糖。
lines.en: I laugh out loud with sugar stuck to my teeth.
I lose a fair amount of sugar crumbs.
I step back and my smile fades.
I press the struck spot.
A tear opens in my skirt.
I let out the faintest hum.
I straighten my hat again.
I lick the sugar off my hand.
I stare at you, eyes cold.
My syrup drips faster.
I smooth my hem.
I glance and smile.
I can make this myself.

lines.zh: 包装上没写字，我闻了闻。
lines.en: No name on the wrapping, so I sniff it.
I take a bite; it is sweet.
I tuck it into my skirt pocket.
I hand you a candy.
I shake my head and push it back.
I taste it and set it down.
It is your teeth I would like.
I keep the wrapper.
You bump me and sugar crumbs fly.
I catch the lollipop pillar.
My skirt picks up syrup.
I step back half a block, smiling.

lines.zh: 你撞碎我裙摆上那层糖壳。
lines.en: You crack the sugar shell along my skirt.
My hat tips a little.
I straighten my hat.
The sweetness makes you cough.
I shift one step aside.

lines.zh: 我笑着让开半步，裙角扫过你。
lines.en: Smiling, I step aside and my skirt brushes you.
Two witches sit in the tower.
We trade a candy.
She stirs the syrup in the pot.
We taste the same pot.
When she laughs, so do I.
Our hands meet in the sugar.
We count the candy bricks together.
Neither of us stands up.
Between them it is sweet and quiet.
We look down from the tower together.
I bend and pick up the candy.

lines.zh: 我用袖子把糖上的灰抹掉。
lines.en: I wipe the dust off the candy with my sleeve.
I hold it up to the light.

lines.zh: 我一整个塞进嘴，腮帮鼓起来。
lines.en: I stuff it in whole and my cheek bulges.

lines.zh: 我塞进围裙口袋，拍了拍。
lines.en: I tuck it in my apron pocket and pat it flat.
I weigh it; it is light.

lines.zh: 我掰开它，里头的馅还在往外流。
lines.en: I snap it open and the filling still runs out.
I offer you half.
I look and toss it away.
I wrap it in the paper.

lines.zh: 手一垂，袖子里的糖罐就响。
lines.en: My hand drops and the sweet jar in my sleeve rattles.

lines.zh: 我认出你不是来买糖的。
lines.en: I see you are not here for candy.

lines.zh: 我提着裙子，慢慢踱到你面前。
lines.en: Lifting my skirt, I stroll up in front of you.
The smile on my face has not changed.
I mutter something short.
I crush a candy in my hand.
My skirt suddenly billows.

lines.zh: 糖门在我背后合拢，没有一丝缝。
lines.en: The candy door shuts behind me without a seam.

lines.zh: 你站在第几块糖砖上，我清楚。
lines.en: I know exactly which sugar brick you stand on.

lines.zh: 我抬手指向你，指甲上全是糖。
lines.en: I raise a hand at you, sugar under every nail.
I follow you around the candy pillar.

lines.zh: 你拐过糖柱，我已在另一头。
lines.en: You round the candy pillar and I am already there.
I move along the wall, light-footed.
I suddenly appear in front of you.

lines.zh: 你每退一格，我就先到一格。
lines.en: Every block you retreat, I am there first.
My syrup drips on the floor.
You step on a soft candy.

lines.zh: 我一直保持着这个距离。
lines.en: I keep this distance.
I watch you from the tower.

lines.zh: 背后那只手，正捏着一颗薄荷糖。
lines.en: Behind my back, that hand is kneading a mint.
I fling a string of mints.

lines.zh: 我旋身把糖甩到你脸上。
lines.en: I spin and whip candy at your face.
I slap a palm at your chest.

lines.zh: 我的指甲划过你的手背。
lines.en: My nails rake your hand.
Syrup glues your feet.

lines.zh: 你被甜味呛得喘不过气。
lines.en: The sweetness chokes you.
I laugh and add another blow.

lines.zh: 我把一颗糖塞进你嘴里。
lines.en: I stuff a candy into your mouth.
I grab hold of your wrist.
You pull back; the candy sticks.
A smell of sugar fills the tower.
I come out from behind a syrup curtain.
A pair of footprints appears on the candy bricks.
I stand in the doorway, smiling.
The pot starts to bubble.
You hear candy wrappers rustle.

lines.zh: 糖浆还没干，我就从塔上下来了。
lines.en: The syrup is still wet when I come down the tower.
The air turns cloyingly sweet.

lines.zh: 我把手里那颗糖抛起来。
lines.en: I toss a candy in the air.
I begin walking this floor.
The candy bricks on the wall glint.

lines.zh: 我的裙子先出现在转角。
lines.en: My skirt shows around the corner first.
My candy starts melting and I swat at it.

lines.zh: 我从塔上摔下，糖砖碎了。
lines.en: I fall from the tower and candy bricks shatter.

lines.zh: 糖浆把我裹住，我动不了。
lines.en: Syrup coats me and I cannot move.
The blast flips me in my skirt.
An arrow lodges in my candy staff.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的咒语按住了。
lines.en: That force silences my spell.
Hunger sets both my hands shaking.
Lightning strikes and the candy scorches.

lines.zh: 塔底没了，我一路掉下去。
lines.en: The tower floor is gone; I fall.
